purpose: Sole targeted A/B for coverage Order 94 generic hypothesis 3: stop repeated parameter-variant read loops from dominating Multi-Apps recovery search.
change_scope: Hypothesis 3/3: classify file.read_text as read-only, fully exclude a read-only action from recovery after two distinct argument variants each reach an episode block, and make Multi-Apps search honor excluded_actions like all other domains. This only constrains repeated tool selection; it does not parse the task, inspect file content, choose a replacement, alter model arguments, execute an answer, or decide completion. Model, prompt, Adapter capabilities, VM, evaluator, top_k, and step budget are unchanged.

implementation_evidence.prior_failure: The model read the source, ran the unchanged script, used file.write_text to save the wrong stdout to log.txt, and then repeatedly selected two parameter variants of file.read_text. Both variants reached episode blocks, but Multi-Apps tools_search still returned file.read_text because excluded_actions was ignored in that branch.
implementation_evidence.prior_audit_interruption_note: The audit observed qwen3.5-4b on all 15 completed responses with zero leakage, action mismatch, argument rewrite, or injection. valid=false only because request 16 was written before interruption and has no response.
implementation_evidence.counterfactuals: An unrelated /tmp/counterfactual/notes.py read remains available after one blocked argument variant. After two different read variants each repeat to an episode block, a generic edit-source search excludes file.read_text while preserving other actions. No benchmark identifier, source, output, path, or answer is used.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

selection.method: single targeted A/B for generic hypothesis 3 of coverage Order 94
selection.rerun_reason: The preserved v63 trace proves a reusable recovery defect: two blocked read variants remained searchable in Multi-Apps. This v64 run is the only A/B for hypothesis 3 and does not repeat either earlier hypothesis.
selection.on_failure: Preserve the result, mark Order 94 task_blocked because its baseline plus all three generic hypotheses are exhausted, and immediately advance to Order 95. Do not run a fourth hypothesis or repeat v64 unchanged.
